description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing hooks for lifecycle management and logging initialization.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class extending FragmentActivity, providing lifecycle handling and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the default onCreate method to set up the activity. Currently it only calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the default onStart method to initialize logging when the activity starts.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by creating a LogWrapper and directing log output through it, and logs a 'Ready' message.
